chapter_meta_description: The Diancai Immortal faces the Wind and Fire tribulations on his path to Celestial Immortality. Witness a masterclass in Xianxia world-building as Ji Ning watches his master's fate hang in the balance.

og_description: The Diancai Immortal endures the first two trials of his Heavenly Tribulation. Can his sword arts and steel will see him through the coming lightning storm?
twitter_title: The Storm Before Immortality | Desolate Era Ch. 407
twitter_description: The Wind and Fire tribulations are a brutal test of spirit. But the most dangerous trial, the Lightning Tribulation, is just beginning.

lore_anchors.definition: The mandatory trial of tribulation faced by cultivators seeking to transcend mortality. It consists of four stages: Wind, Fire, Lightning, and Heartfiend.
The final stage of the Wind Tribulation, a formless, unstoppable energy that enters the body through the crown of the head to test the cultivator's Dao-heart.
The final stage of the Fire Tribulation, a primordial flame that burns within the cultivator's body to temper their physical form.
A cultivator's core spiritual resolve and emotional foundation. A weak Dao-heart is vulnerable to the Celestial Wind and Heartfiend Tribulations.
A high-level immortal being who has transcended mortality by passing the full Heavenly Tribulation. They are free from the traps of the Three Realms.
An advanced level of sword mastery demonstrated by the Diancai Immortal, combining the power of Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water.
